title: Emerald&Stuffs
description: This Mod adds Emerald Armor & Tools (NeoForge)
body:
# **💚 Emerald&Stuffs**

Emerald&Stuffs expands Minecraft’s emerald theme beyond trading and villages, turning this iconic gem into powerful, usable gear.

This mod adds a full Emerald Armor set and Emerald Tools, giving players a new progression path that sits proudly alongside vanilla materials. Whether you’re mining deep underground or standing your ground in battle, emerald gear offers a fresh way to shine.

## **✨ Features**

🛡️ Full Emerald Armor set
Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots

⛏️ Emerald Tools
Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe, and Sword

⚙️ Simple, vanilla-friendly balance

🌍 Designed to fit naturally into survival gameplay

Emerald&Stuffs is lightweight, easy to install, and perfect for players who want more uses for emeralds without changing the core Minecraft experience.

### Created using MCreator
